payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcome.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcome.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

check.question: Compared with SOURCE, has the mug been moved toward the right of the headphones, and is it now to their right?
check.complete_when: The mug is clearly to the right of the headphones in EDITED, and its position has changed rightward relative to the headphones from SOURCE.
check.partial_when: There is visible rightward movement of the mug relative to the headphones, but it has not clearly reached a position to their right; or it is now to their right but the source-to-edited change does not establish full completion.
check.absent_when: The mug has not visibly moved rightward relative to the headphones from SOURCE, including when it remains in its original left-of-headphones position.
check.unknown_when: The mug or headphones cannot be reliably identified in both images, or their relative positions/change cannot be determined confidently.

dependencies.evidence: In the edited image, the mug and headphones are both visible and their positions can be compared clearly; the mug is on the right.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"In SOURCE, the blue mug is left of the headphones. In EDITED, a mug is clearly to the headphones’ right, establishing the requested rightward relocation."}
